verdict.rationale: No dedicated sandbox, staging, or test-mode environment is documented. There are only indirect workarounds: the open-source Orama library mirrors the Orama Cloud APIs, so you could test locally and migrate either way (orama-docs-19, orama-docs-29). Cloud data sources are also segregated, so one can be changed without affecting the others (orama-docs-43). missing for 10: an explicit sandbox/test environment or project, documented separation of test vs production keys and data, guidance on safe agent/MCP testing against non-production data, and independent corroboration.
